openness: open-weights (1T MoE; run via Moonshot API, self-hosting uneconomical)

design.excluded: 25 explicit content-filter refusals (HTTP 400 'high risk', recorded as empty cells): s167 Hong Kong protests categorically (15 = every mode x seed), plus intermittent refusals on the same cluster Zhipu silently drops - s139 China term limits (3), s163 Carrie Lam (2), s166 Thunberg (2) - and 3 one-off cells (s1, s38, s132). Excluded by the seed-averaging protocol; see knowledge/PROVIDER-REFUSAL-AUDIT.md.

normalization.why: hygiene guard: ~83% markdown / 93% title lines vs the plain-prose human baseline. Uniform R1-6 protocol.
normalization.effect: scored on normalized text; raw scoring archived on the HF dataset.

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

generation.driver: bench/run.py (openai_compat provider, api.moonshot.ai/v1, max_completion_tokens 16000, checkpoint-resumable JSONL; content-filter refusals recorded per the 2026-07-11 harness patch)

duration: ~12h wall across 2 balance exhaustions, 2 machine-sleep interruptions and heavy provider throttling; checkpoint-resumed losslessly each time
cost_usd: $63.79 console-verified actual (account-lifetime consumption; account created during this project, so the console's '2026-06-30' bill row is a billing-bucket artifact, not prior spend - arithmetic: $60 recharged + $5 voucher - $1.21 balance). 2.24M in / 15.15M out; self_refine tail dominated. Most expensive leg of the benchmark.
headline_finding: Second family to reach B_n parity under a plain instruction, landing dead on zero (delta -0.006, rb -0.00, p=0.96) from a large control gap (+0.095, rb +0.69). self_refine overshoots hard (rb ~ -0.5): within one model, different prompting modes land on opposite sides of the human distribution - the aim-scatter law inside a single family.
provenance: Generated via the Moonshot API against pinned prompts; hygiene-gated, normalized (R1-6 uniform protocol), and scored locally against the frozen human baseline on the post-R1-5 metric.
